question:
What will come in the place of '?’ in the following equation, if ‘+' and ‘÷' are interchanged and ‘x' and ‘-’ are interchanged?

27 ÷ 14 x 21 + 3 - 4 = ?
solution:
Given Equation: 

27 ÷ 14 x 21 + 3 - 4 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

After interchanging ‘+' and ‘÷' and ‘x' and ‘-’, we get

27 + 14 - __21 ÷3__ x 4 

⇒ 27 + 14 - __7 x 4__ 

⇒ 41 - 28 = 13 

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
